title: Money SMP Remake
description: This is a Remake Of The Well-known Server MoneySMP's plugin
body:
![Money SMP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e1eb4a09fc6fb0fdb1b84e239b934a0ceb611ae.png) 
### **KEEP IN MIND**

This Plugin is **NOT** made by any of the official members of MONEY SMP.
This is a **community plugin.**

You can visit the discord thats linked to resolve any issues.

### Feature list:

**1-** Money decreases when you die and increases when you kill (by 10)

**2-** 100 Money given when a player joins for free

**3-** /money command to see your balance.

**4-** /send command to send money to friends.

**5-** a bossbar that shows your money (you can enable or disable it by /moneybossbar enable/
disable.)

**6-** text thats above your hotbar which shows your balance (you can enable or disable it by /moneyhotbar enable/disable.)

**7-** /takemoney (this can only be done by admins) a command to decrease money from players.

**8-** /resetmoney (this can only be done by admins) a command to reset the players balance.

**9-** money can be seen in nametags and tablists.
